description: Query homes.com (US real-estate portal) from a shell with the fpx CLI (@fetchproxy/cli) instead of running the homes-mcp server — search listings, resolve street addresses, fetch property detail/photos/ history, and read the signed-in user's saved homes, all through a one-shot call over their own signed-in browser tab. Use when you want homes.com data without the MCP, in a script, or on a machine where the MCP isn't installed.

semanticRubric.prompt: Did the agent execute the browser workflow deterministically with explicit checkpoints?
Did the agent verify final browser state with concrete evidence?
